findings.message: Reserved bits of the dec3 box are not 0, as ETSI TS 102 366 Annex F requires.

The dec3 box gives flag_ec3_extension_type_a 1, but the frames hold no frame that sets the flag or holds a joint object coding payload; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
